text.content:
Cowboys riding shotgun on the freight trains.

Turf: Arroyo's rail yards and freight lines
Known for: Guarding cargo on the trains; revolvers, shotguns and an Old West code
Leadership: Delta Hurston, daughter of "Gunslinger" Hurston
Allies & rivals: Patron: 6th Street, which takes half the fee. The General calls them his cavalry

A cowboy posergang that has ridden shotgun on the city's freight trains since before 2045. In 2047 "Gunslinger" Hurston kept them off the second Purge List by guarding the right cargo, and somebody owed him. His daughter Delta Hurston runs them now on the Arroyo freight lines, under 6th Street's wing.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.04
